source_caption_text:
Atlanta Police Officer Is Going Viral For Adapting To The Local Slang, Leaving The Internet Cracking Up Over The Way He Talks 😭😂

“That sh** clean tho twin”

Social media is having a field day after a video surfaced of an Atlanta police officer casually using the city’s signature slang while interacting with locals. His delivery sounded so natural that viewers couldn’t help but find the unexpected interaction hilarious.

One person even said, “he talk like us but he doesnt look like us” 😭😭

Atlanta has always been influential when it comes to slang, hip-hop, fashion, and culture, and this officer is another example of just how much the city’s culture can rub off on those who spend time there.

The ATL influence is undefeated! 😂🔥
